'''Taratos IV''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Clone Wars Gambit: Stealth" /> located in the [[Taratos system/Legends|Taratos system]], in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Bant'ena Fhernan]] traveled to [[Niriktavi Bay]] on Taratos IV to study the world's [[Niriktavi coral]], which Fhernan suspected had some [[Antibiotic/Legends|antibacterial]] properties. However, while Fhernan and her team were on the planet, the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] annexed the world. Large numbers of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] landed on Taratos IV and [[Death/Legends|killed]] Fhernan's team, while Fhernan herself was captured.<ref name="Clone Wars Gambit: Stealth" />
